item.title: ams OSRAM sues distributor over alleged infringement by Refond automotive LEDs
item.summary: ams OSRAM said it filed two patent infringement lawsuits in Germany against Shenzhen Refond Optoelectronics over automotive LED products. The move adds to a broader wave of intellectual property disputes in the LED sector and targets ceramic-packaged and EMC-packaged vehicle lighting products sold by the Chinese supplier.
